data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve card details from BIN number
data.description_suggestion: Looks up card information for a given BIN (Bank Identification Number) or IIN (Issuer Identification Number). Accepts the first 6-8 digits of a card number and returns the card scheme, funding type, issuer name, and issuer country. Keyless requests are rate-limited per IP address per day; providing an IPNOVA API key increases the rate limit. Returns card metadata or an error if the BIN is not found or invalid.
